music.name: Stellar Tracks
music.author: MaxStack
music.description: This is music that was made for a cancelled video game. The album was called Game-Game, but I chose to name it Stellar Tracks because I liked the music so much! It also gave me the feeling of a cosmic train going to different worlds.

music.name: Endgame: Singularity
music.author: MaxStack
music.description: This music combines strong melodies with an ominous feel. That is quite rare (I'm not sure why), but it works really well here.

music.name: Carnival Rides
music.author: Écrivain
music.description: This is a short but fun track. It gives me the feeling of a fast minecart.

music.name: Telling a Tale
music.author: Remaxim
music.description: Another short track, this one evokes the atmosphere of a medieval campfire. It is quite compelling!

music.name: Left and Right Excluded
music.author: Matthew Klingensmith
music.description: If jazz music was combined with a battle theme, this would be the result. It is both unusual and fun!

music.name: Debugging
music.author: Martin Linda
music.description: This music gives me the feeling of a programmer picking up speed. I would have bought this if it was being sold!

music.name: Town Stream
music.author: AVGVSTA
music.description: This track is pleasant and calm. It was originally just named Town, but I added the Stream part because I felt it deserved a more distinctive name.

music.name: Delightful Delving
music.author: AVGVSTA
music.description: This music is meant for a video game dungeon. Unlike most tracks of that category, this one has an optimistic tone with a sense of adventure.

music.name: Gem Maze
music.author: Mopz
music.description: I immediately loved this music when I first listened to it. It has a good flow paired with a strong melody.

music.name: Parting the Moss (version 1)
music.author: Przemysław Sikorski
music.description: I have listened to this music over and over again. It so catchy and delightful!

music.name: Parting the Moss (version 2)
music.author: Przemysław Sikorski
music.description: This is similar to the first version of Parting the Moss but is more fast-paced. I also love this track, so I decided to keep it as well!

music.name: Swagger
music.author: LushoGames
music.description: This isn't the kind of music I usually listen to, but it was so good I had to keep it! It gives me the feeling of a humanoid crocodile with heavy armor walking through town with no small swagger.

music.name: Warped
music.author: Alexander Ehlers
music.description: This music has a mystical atmosphere with an undercurrent of danger. I found myself humming this music, which told me how good it is.

music.name: Mystical Caverns
music.author: MichaelTheCrow
music.description: I like how this music has a stronger melody compared to most cave tracks. It has a sense of both mystery and adventure.

music.name: Freelance
music.author: MaxStack
music.description: There are two tracks in here. BazaarNet is both magical and hopeful. The Client, on the other hand, is ominous. However, it is also catchy, which is unusual but works really well!
